messages:
deploy-bot: queued staged rollout v2 -> api-gateway (canary 5%) [deploy id: db-20260320-09]

alex: kicking off canary, monitoring telemetry for 10m :eyes:

maria: seeing a bump in 422s from mobile clients, small sample attached

maria: ```
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] client=mobile-iphone SDK=1.0.2 path=/v2/chat status=422 body={"error":"missing model_version header"}
[2026-03-20T15:03:05Z] client=mobile-android SDK=1.0.2 path=/v2/chat status=422 body={"error":"missing model_version header"}
```

sam: fwiw SDK 1.x had logic that drops unknown headers when a proxy set `normalizeHeaders=true` — seen this with some CDN edge configs

cheng: ops, can we pause the canary while we triage? this looks client-impacting for mobile users

ops-oncall: pausing canary now. deploy-bot: `pause-rollout db-20260320-09`

deploy-bot: rollout db-20260320-09 paused at 5% canary (reason: manual pause by ops-oncall)

alex: thanks. initial quick plan: 1) pin mobile tenant(s) to v1 routing, 2) add lightweight gateway shim to map legacy header `X-Client-Meta` -> `X-Model-Version`, 3) SDK team ships 1.0.3 to stop dropping headers, 4) resume canary after SDK patch ramps

maria: started PR for shim (https://git.internal/r/redwood/shims/pull/987) — small lua filter, tested in staging

maria: shim snippet:
```json
{
  "filter": "if request.headers['x-model-version'] == nil and request.headers['x-client-meta'] then request.headers['x-model-version'] = request.headers['x-client-meta'] end"
}
```

sdk-team: we will cut 1.0.3 that preserves unknown headers and add a unit to opt-out of normalization. ETA 17:00 PT

sam: do we consider full rollback? seems limited to older SDKs, prefer tenant-pin + shim while SDK ships rather than global rollback

cheng: agree. applying tenant pin for mobile-prod now: `deployctl tenant-pin --tenant mobile-prod --route /v2 --target v1 --expires 24h`

deploy-bot: tenant-pin applied: mobile-prod -> v1 for /v2 (expires in 24h) [action id: pin-20260320-01]

ops-oncall: verifying traffic: mobile-prod 200 OKs back to baseline, 422 rate down to ~0.5% (was 6% at peak)

alex: great. action items:
- sdk-team: publish 1.0.3 and post release link here
- maria: merge shim PR and promote to prod (canary off)
- docs: update release notes + migration note for SDK 1.x

sdk-team: will post release link when cut

maria: merged shim to main, will rollout a short canary for shim then promote

alex: we'll hold global v2 rollout until mobile SDK uptake > 50% and errors < 0.2% for 30m. Resume steps documented in release playbook.

sam: noted. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

alex: leaving follow-up for postmortem/notes in the release ticket with timeline and telemetry graphs

ops-oncall: closing incident slack thread, monitoring continues (reacts :eyes:)
